estoque_carbono.methodology: Stocks from the Fourth National Inventory, rasterized at 100 m and summed over the five pools. The total is density multiplied by the geodesic area of the pixel, and it matches the original vector to within 0.03%.

solo_carbono.methodology: Soil organic carbon from 0 to 30 cm, MapBiomas Soil collection 2, 30 m.

biomassa_esa_lenhosa.methodology: Aboveground biomass of woody vegetation, ESA CCI Biomass. The series has a gap: 2007, 2010 and from 2015 onwards.

gfw_netflux.methodology: Net forest carbon flux, Global Forest Watch. A negative value is removal from the atmosphere and a positive one is emission; the document replaces the sign with a word.

lulc_mapbiomas.coverageContext: in this land use and cover class
lulc_mapbiomas.methodology: Land use and land cover, MapBiomas collection 10.1, 30 m, annual series from 1985 onwards.

fogo_frequencia.methodology: Cumulative fire frequency since 1985, MapBiomas Fire collection 3. Areas that never burned count as zero.

gpp_modis.methodology: Gross primary productivity, MODIS MOD17A2HGF, classified into five classes by Jenks over the biome.

npp_modis.methodology: Net primary productivity, MODIS MOD17A3HGF, classified into five classes by Jenks over the biome.

chirps_precip.methodology: Cumulative annual precipitation, daily CHIRPS summed over the year.

ndvi_modis.methodology: NDVI, MODIS MOD13Q1, mean of the 16-day composites of the year.

narrative.fluxEmission: In {feature}, the {layer} layer indicates that the area emitted an average of {value}{atYear}.
narrative.fluxRemoval: In {feature}, the {layer} layer indicates that the area removed an average of {value}{atYear}.
narrative.fluxNeutral: In {feature}, the {layer} layer indicates that the area is in balance, with an average of {value}{atYear}.
narrative.continuous: In {feature}, the {layer} layer averages {mean}{atYear}, ranging from {min} to {max}.
narrative.categorical: In {feature}, the predominant class of {layer} is {class}, with {share}% of the analyzed area {context}{yearClause}.
narrative.stocksTotal: In {feature}, the total carbon stock is {total} {unit} over {area} ha, an average density of {density} {unit}/ha.
narrative.stocksBreakdown: The {pool} pool accounts for {poolShare}% of the total, and the {class} phytophysiognomy for {classShare}%.
narrative.trendStable: Compared with {year}, the value remained stable.
narrative.context: Over the {first} to {last} series, the mean is {mean}, with a maximum of {max} in {maxYear} and a minimum of {min} in {minYear}.
